tools.name: hopi_add_working_days
tools.description: Add or subtract a number of working days (Monday to Friday) from a start date, optionally skipping England and Wales bank holidays. Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format. Bank holiday data covers 2026 to 2028 only, so outside those years just weekends are skipped. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/add-working-days/

days.description: Number of working days to move (0 to 100000)

direction.description: 'add' to count forwards, 'sub' to count backwards (default 'add')

bankHolidays.description: Also skip England and Wales bank holidays, not just weekends (default true)

tools.name: hopi_age_calculator
tools.description: Work out an exact age from a date of birth, as of today or an optional 'as of' date. Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format. Returns the age in years, months and days, the total days lived, and the next birthday. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/age-calculator/

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

asOf.description: Optional date to measure the age at, in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

tools.name: hopi_ai_prompt_builder
tools.description: Build a well-structured prompt to paste into an AI chatbot or image generator. Give the task plus any of: the role the AI should take, background, audience, tone, format, length, things to avoid, an example of good output, and material to work on (for summarise, analyse and code tasks). taskType image switches to style, lighting, composition and aspect ratio instead. target formats the prompt for 'chatgpt' (Markdown headings, the task repeated after long material, as OpenAI's guidance suggests), 'claude' (XML tags with long material first and the task last, as Anthropic recommends), 'gemini' (Markdown with the question after the context, as Google recommends) or 'any'. Returns the prompt, a checklist of which parts are present, vague words found, and the word count with a rough token estimate (characters divided by 4). Nothing is sent to any AI. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/ai-prompt-builder/

task.description: What the AI should do (for images: what the image should show)

target.description: Which AI to format the prompt for; default any (ignored for images)

role.description: Who the AI should be, e.g. 'A UK consumer rights adviser'

context.description: Background the AI needs: the situation, facts and figures

length.description: Length: one sentence, one short paragraph, under 100/250/500 words, about 1,000 words, or as long as it needs

example.description: A short example of what good output looks like

material.description: Text, data or code to work on (used for summarise, analyse and code)

language.description: Programming language and tools (code tasks only)

askQuestions.description: Ask the AI to ask clarifying questions before it starts

explainReasoning.description: Ask the AI to explain its main choices after answering

composition.description: Composition and camera, e.g. 'close-up, low angle' (image tasks only)

tools.name: hopi_alcohol_unit_calculator
tools.description: Work out UK alcohol units in a drink from its ABV (percentage) and volume (millilitres), using units = ABV x ml / 1000. Optionally give the number of those drinks per week to get a weekly total compared against the NHS low risk guideline of 14 units a week. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/alcohol-unit-calculator/

abv.description: Alcohol by volume as a percentage, e.g. 12 for 12% wine

ml.description: Volume of the drink in millilitres, e.g. 175 for a medium glass of wine

drinksPerWeek.description: Optional number of these drinks per week, to work out a weekly units total

tools.name: hopi_alphabetical_order
tools.description: Sort the lines of a block of text into alphabetical order. Blank lines are dropped. Uses natural en-GB ordering so numbers within lines sort sensibly. Can sort ascending (A to Z) or descending (Z to A), and can ignore case. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/alphabetical-order/

text.description: The text to sort, one item per line

direction.description: 'asc' for A to Z (default), 'desc' for Z to A

caseInsensitive.description: Ignore letter case when sorting (default false)

tools.name: hopi_angle_converter
tools.description: Convert an angle from one unit to another. Units: deg (degrees), rad (radians), grad (gradians), turn (full turns). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/angle-converter/

tools.name: hopi_area_converter
tools.description: Convert an area from one unit to another. Units: sqm (square metres), sqft (square feet), sqyd (square yards), acre (acres), ha (hectares), sqkm (square kilometres), sqmi (square miles). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/area-converter/

tools.name: hopi_aspect_ratio_calculator
tools.description: Aspect ratio helper. In 'simplify' mode, give width and height to get the simplified W:H ratio, decimal ratio and nearest common ratio. In 'solve' mode, give a ratio (ratioW:ratioH) plus one of width or height to get the missing side. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/aspect-ratio-calculator/

mode.description: 'simplify' a width and height, or 'solve' a missing side from a ratio

width.description: Width in pixels or units (simplify mode, or the known side in solve mode)

height.description: Height in pixels or units (simplify mode, or the known side in solve mode)

tools.name: hopi_average_calculator
tools.description: Work out the mean, median, mode, sum, count, minimum and maximum of a list of numbers. Provide the numbers separated by spaces, commas, semicolons or new lines (type 1200 rather than 1,200, as commas are treated as separators). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/average-calculator/

numbers.description: A list of numbers separated by spaces, commas, semicolons or new lines

tools.name: hopi_base32_encoder
tools.description: Encode text to RFC 4648 Base32 or decode Base32 back to text. Encoding maps the UTF-8 bytes of the text into 5-bit groups using the alphabet A to Z then 2 to 7, padded to a multiple of 8 characters with equals signs. Decoding tolerates lowercase input and missing padding, and reports characters outside the alphabet as an error. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/base32-encoder/

mode.description: 'encode' turns text into Base32, 'decode' turns Base32 back into text (default encode)

text.description: The text to encode, or the Base32 string to decode

tools.name: hopi_base64
tools.description: Encode text to Base64, or decode a Base64 string back to text. UTF-8 safe, so accents and emoji survive the round trip. Returns the converted text or a clear error. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/base64/

text.description: The text to encode, or the Base64 string to decode

mode.description: 'encode' text to Base64, or 'decode' Base64 back to text

tools.name: hopi_bill_splitter
tools.description: Split a restaurant bill between people. In 'itemised' mode, list each item with its amount and who shared it, then add an optional tip and service charge (both percentages applied to each person's own share). In 'even' mode, split one total evenly with an optional tip. Amounts in GBP. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/bill-splitter/

mode.description: 'itemised' splits by item and who had it; 'even' splits one total equally

people.description: Itemised mode: names of the people sharing the bill

items.description: Itemised mode: each item with its amount and the names who shared it. An item with no names is shared by everyone.

assigned.description: Names sharing this item; omit or empty for everyone

servicePercent.description: Itemised mode: service charge as a percentage (default 0)

total.description: Even mode: the bill total before tip

peopleCount.description: Even mode: number of people to split between

tools.name: hopi_bingo_card_generator
tools.description: Generate one or more UK 90-ball bingo cards. Each card is a 3-row by 9-column grid holding 15 numbers, 5 per row, with each column drawing from its own decade (1 to 9, 10 to 19, and so on up to 80 to 90). Blank squares are null. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/bingo-card-generator/

count.description: How many cards to generate, 1 to 100 (default 1)

tools.name: hopi_birthday_magic_square
tools.description: Build Ramanujan's birthday magic square: a 4 x 4 grid whose top row is a date (day, month, first two digits of the year, last two digits) and whose rows, columns, diagonals and many other groups of four all add up to the same total. Pass date as YYYY-MM-DD (order dmy for day first, the UK way, or mdy for month first), or pass numbers as any four whole numbers instead. With neither, it uses today's local date. Returns the square, the magic total and every group of four cells that adds up to it, with cells as [row, column] counted from 1 at the top left. builtIn is true for the 44 groups that always work and false for lucky coincidences. hasNegative and hasRepeats flag squares that use negative or repeated numbers. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/birthday-magic-square/

date.description: The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 1887-12-22 for Ramanujan's birthday. Defaults to today when numbers is not given.

order.description: dmy puts the day first (UK style, 22 12 18 87); mdy puts the month first (US style, 12 22 18 87)

numbers.description: Instead of a date: any four whole numbers from -999,999 to 999,999 for the top row, for example [22, 12, 18, 87]

tools.name: hopi_bitcoin_address_validator
tools.description: Check whether a Bitcoin address is valid by verifying its checksum and structure. Supports legacy Base58Check (P2PKH, P2SH) and Bech32/Bech32m SegWit and Taproot addresses, on mainnet and testnet. Does not query the blockchain or check balances. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/bitcoin-address-validator/

tools.name: hopi_bmi_calculator
tools.description: Work out body mass index (BMI) from height and weight, with the NHS weight category. Use units 'metric' with heightCm and weightKg, or 'imperial' with heightInches and weightPounds. BMI = weight in kg / (height in metres squared). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/bmi-calculator/

tools.name: hopi_body_fat_calculator
tools.description: Estimate body fat percentage using the US Navy tape method from a few measurements. For males give height, neck and waist; for females give height, neck, waist and hip. Use units 'metric' (centimetres) or 'imperial' (inches). Optionally give weight (kg for metric, pounds for imperial) to also get fat mass and lean mass in kilograms. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/body-fat-calculator/

sex.description: Biological sex, determines the formula and whether hip is needed

height.description: Height (cm if metric, inches if imperial)

neck.description: Neck circumference (cm if metric, inches if imperial)

waist.description: Waist circumference (cm if metric, inches if imperial)

hip.description: Hip circumference, females only (cm if metric, inches if imperial)

weight.description: Optional weight (kg if metric, pounds if imperial) for fat and lean mass

tools.name: hopi_caesar_cipher
tools.description: Encode or decode text with a Caesar shift cipher. Each letter is moved along the alphabet by the shift amount; a shift of 13 is ROT13. Only A to Z letters are changed, everything else is left as is. Decoding applies the opposite shift. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/caesar-cipher/

shift.description: How many places to shift each letter (e.g. 3, or 13 for ROT13)

mode.description: 'encode' to apply the shift, 'decode' to reverse it (default encode)

tools.name: hopi_cagr_calculator
tools.description: Work out the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) that takes a starting value to an ending value over a number of years. Returns the annual rate, the total growth and the growth multiple. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/cagr-calculator/

start.description: Starting value (must be greater than zero)

years.description: Number of years over the period (may be a fraction)

tools.name: hopi_calories_to_kj
tools.description: Convert food energy between kilocalories (kcal) and kilojoules (kJ) using the exact factor 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ. Give an amount and its unit ('kcal' or 'kj'); returns both values. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/calories-to-kj/

unit.description: The unit of the amount: 'kcal' (kilocalories) or 'kj' (kilojoules)

tools.name: hopi_captcha_embed_code_generator
tools.description: Generate the embed code for a CAPTCHA on a web form plus the server code that checks the token. Providers: turnstile (Cloudflare Turnstile), hcaptcha, recaptcha2 (reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox), recaptcha3 (reCAPTCHA v3 score) and altcha (self-hosted proof of work, no account). Servers: php, node (Express), python (Flask), cloudflare (Pages Function), netlify (Netlify Function) and vercel (Vercel Function), plus two form services that check the token themselves, so no server code is returned: netlify-forms (reCAPTCHA v2 only; with no site key Netlify supplies its own reCAPTCHA) and formspree (not altcha). ALTCHA server code is given for node and python only. The secret key is never asked for: the server code reads it from an environment variable. Set useTestKey to use the provider's official always-pass test site key (not available for recaptcha3 or altcha). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/captcha-embed-code-generator/

server.description: Where the form is handled: your own server, a serverless function, or a form service that checks the token itself

siteKey.description: Your public site key (letters, numbers, - and _). Leave empty for a YOUR_SITE_KEY placeholder. Ignored for altcha

useTestKey.description: Use the provider's official test site key, which always passes

theme.description: Widget theme. auto is Turnstile's automatic theme and the default look elsewhere. Ignored for recaptcha3 and altcha

size.description: Widget size. flexible is Turnstile only. Ignored for recaptcha3 and altcha

language.description: Widget language code such as fr or pt-BR; empty means automatic. Ignored for recaptcha3 and altcha

action.description: Action name. Optional for turnstile (up to 32 letters, numbers, - and _), defaults to submit for recaptcha3; checked on the server. Ignored for the others

threshold.description: recaptcha3 only: lowest score to accept, 0.1 to 0.9. Ignored for the form services, which run the check themselves

tools.name: hopi_case_converter
tools.description: Convert text to a different letter case. 'upper' is UPPERCASE, 'lower' is lowercase, 'title' capitalises the first letter of each word, and 'sentence' capitalises the first letter of each sentence. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/case-converter/

mode.description: The target case

tools.name: hopi_cat_age_calculator
tools.description: Convert a cat's age in years to an approximate human age, using the standard 15, 24, then 4 a year chart. Returns the human-equivalent age and the cat's life stage. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/cat-age-calculator/

catAge.description: The cat's age in years (0 to 40)

tools.name: hopi_celsius_to_fahrenheit
tools.description: Convert a temperature between Celsius and Fahrenheit. Also returns Kelvin. Set direction to 'c-to-f' or 'f-to-c'. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/celsius-to-fahrenheit/

direction.description: 'c-to-f' converts Celsius to Fahrenheit, 'f-to-c' converts Fahrenheit to Celsius

tools.name: hopi_character_counter
tools.description: Count the characters in a block of text, including a count with spaces removed, the word count, how many SMS messages it would take to send, and the Twitter/X characters remaining out of 280. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/character-counter/

tools.name: hopi_cipher_identifier
tools.description: Identify what encoding or classical cipher a piece of text probably is (Base64, Base32, hex, binary, octal or decimal ASCII, URL encoding, HTML entities, Morse, Caesar or ROT-N, Atbash, reversed text) or recognise it as a UUID, IPv4 address, Unix timestamp, JWT or hash digest. Returns ranked candidates with confidence and a decoded preview, then auto-decodes nested layers (up to 8) while a step is at least 60% confident. Cannot break keyed encryption such as AES. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/cipher-identifier/

text.description: The unknown text to identify and decode

tools.name: hopi_cm_to_feet
tools.description: Convert a height between centimetres and feet/inches. Direction 'cm-to-feet' takes cm and returns feet and inches. Direction 'feet-to-cm' takes feet and inches and returns cm. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/cm-to-feet/

tools.name: hopi_cmyk_to_rgb
tools.description: Convert print CMYK values (each 0 to 100) to on-screen RGB and hex, or convert RGB (each 0 to 255) the other way to CMYK. Uses the standard device-independent conversion. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/cmyk-to-rgb/

mode.description: Direction of conversion

tools.name: hopi_coin_flip
tools.description: Flip a fair coin one or more times. Returns each result plus a tally of heads and tails. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/coin-flip/

count.description: How many coins to flip, 1 to 10000 (default 1)

tools.name: hopi_collatz_conjecture_calculator
tools.description: Run the Collatz (3n + 1) rule on a positive whole number of up to 1,000 digits: halve it when even, treble it and add 1 when odd, until it reaches 1. Returns the total steps, odd and even step counts, the highest value reached and the step it was reached at, and the path itself (first 1,000 values; pathTruncated says whether it was cut). Exact for any size: n, peak and the path values are decimal strings. Pass big numbers as a digit string, because JSON numbers above 9,007,199,254,740,991 lose precision. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/collatz-conjecture-calculator/

n.description: Starting number: a positive whole number of up to 1,000 digits, as a digit string such as "27" or "837799" (a plain JSON number also works up to 9,007,199,254,740,991)

tools.name: hopi_colour_name_finder
tools.description: Find the named CSS colour that exactly or most closely matches a hex code, using straight-line distance in RGB space across the 148 named CSS colours. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/colour-name-finder/

tools.name: hopi_colour_palette_generator
tools.description: Generate a five-swatch colour palette from a base hex colour using a chosen scheme: analogous, complementary, triadic or mixed. Supporting swatches carry a small random variation, so results vary slightly each call. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/colour-palette-generator/

hex.description: Base colour as a six-digit hex code, e.g. #1F8A70

tools.name: hopi_colour_picker
tools.description: Given a six-digit hex colour code (with or without a leading #), return its hex, RGB and HSL values. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/colour-picker/

tools.name: hopi_colour_shades_generator
tools.description: From a base hex colour, generate five progressively lighter tints (mixed towards white) and five progressively darker shades (mixed towards black), each in five equal steps of one sixth. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/colour-shades-generator/

hex.description: Base colour as a six-digit hex code, e.g. #1F8A70

tools.name: hopi_combination_generator
tools.description: List every way to choose r items from a list, ignoring order (combinations). Returns the total count and the combinations themselves (the first 5000). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/combination-generator/

items.description: The list of items to choose from

choose.description: How many items to pick in each combination (r)

tools.name: hopi_compound_interest_calculator
tools.description: Project savings growth from a starting deposit plus a regular monthly contribution, compounded monthly with contributions added at the end of each month. Returns the final balance, total paid in and interest earned. Amounts in GBP, rate is the annual rate as a percentage. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/compound-interest-calculator/

rate.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage

tools.name: hopi_contrast_checker
tools.description: Work out the WCAG contrast ratio between a foreground (text) colour and a background colour, both as hex codes, and report whether it passes AA and AAA for normal and large text. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/contrast-checker/

foreground.description: Text colour as a six-digit hex code, e.g. #767676

background.description: Background colour as a six-digit hex code, e.g. #FFFFFF

tools.name: hopi_cron_expression_parser
tools.description: Translate a standard five-field cron expression (minute, hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week) into plain English. Understands stars, steps, ranges, lists and month and day names, plus shortcuts like @daily and @hourly. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/cron-expression-parser/

expression.description: A five-field cron expression, for example '*/5 9-17 * * MON-FRI', or a shortcut like @daily

tools.name: hopi_crypto_profit_calculator
tools.description: Work out profit or loss on a crypto trade from buy price, quantity and an optional per-side fee percentage. Returns breakeven price always, and profit, return percentage and total fees once a sell price is given. All figures are treated as GBP. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/crypto-profit-calculator/

sell.description: Sell price per unit (optional; omit to see breakeven only)

fee.description: Fee percentage charged on each side (default 0, must be 0 to under 100)

tools.name: hopi_css_gradient_generator
tools.description: Build a ready-to-use CSS gradient from two colours. Choose a linear gradient with an angle in degrees, or a radial gradient. Returns the gradient value and a full background declaration. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/css-gradient-generator/

angle.description: Angle in degrees for a linear gradient (default 90)

tools.name: hopi_css_minifier
tools.description: Minify CSS by removing comments and needless whitespace, while preserving quoted strings and the spaces inside calc() expressions. Returns the minified CSS with before and after byte sizes. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/css-minifier/

tools.name: hopi_csv_to_json
tools.description: Convert CSV text into a JSON array, following standard CSV quoting rules for embedded commas, quotes and line breaks. With headers on, the first row becomes object keys; with headers off, each row is an array of strings. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/csv-to-json/

firstRowHeaders.description: When true, the first row supplies the object keys; when false, every row becomes a plain array of strings (default true)

tools.name: hopi_cups_to_grams
tools.description: Convert US cups of a common baking ingredient to grams (approximate). Ingredients: flour (plain flour), caster (caster sugar), brown (packed brown sugar), butter, cocoa (cocoa powder), oats, rice (uncooked rice), icing (icing sugar). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/cups-to-grams/

tools.name: hopi_currency_converter
tools.description: Convert an amount of money from one currency to another using Hopi's live mid-market exchange rates (updated hourly, 150+ currencies). Use ISO 4217 codes such as GBP, EUR, USD, JPY. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/currency-converter/

from.description: Currency to convert from, ISO 4217 code e.g. GBP

to.description: Currency to convert to, ISO 4217 code e.g. EUR

tools.name: hopi_data_size_converter
tools.description: Convert a digital storage size between units. Units: B (bytes), KB, MB, GB, TB. By default 1 KB = 1000 bytes (decimal, as storage is sold). Set binary to true for 1 KB = 1024 bytes (as Windows reports drive sizes). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/data-size-converter/

binary.description: Use binary units (1 KB = 1024 bytes) instead of decimal (default false)

tools.name: hopi_date_calculator
tools.description: Add or subtract a number of days, weeks, months or years from a date. Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format. Months and years are clamped to the last day of the target month where needed. Returns the resulting date. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/date-calculator/

amount.description: How many units to move (0 to 100000)

direction.description: 'add' to move forwards, 'subtract' to move backwards (default 'add')

tools.name: hopi_day_of_week_calculator
tools.description: Find which day of the week a given date falls on. Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format. Also reports which weekday that same day and month falls on in the current year. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/day-of-week-calculator/

tools.name: hopi_day_rate_calculator
tools.description: Convert between a contractor day rate and an annual salary equivalent using a chosen number of billable working days per year (default 220). Mode 'to_salary' turns a day rate into yearly, monthly and weekly figures; mode 'to_rate' turns a salary into a day rate. Gross amounts in GBP, before tax. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/day-rate-calculator/

mode.description: 'to_salary' from a day rate, or 'to_rate' from a salary

dayRate.description: Day rate in GBP (required for to_salary)

salary.description: Annual salary in GBP (required for to_rate)

workingDays.description: Billable working days per year, 1 to 365 (default 220)

tools.name: hopi_days_between_dates
tools.description: Count the number of days between two dates, with the total also shown in weeks and in weekdays (Monday to Friday). Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format. Set inclusive to true to count both end days. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/days-between-dates/

inclusive.description: Count both end days rather than excluding the end day (default false)

tools.name: hopi_days_until_christmas
tools.description: Count the number of sleeps until the next Christmas Day (25 December). Uses today's date by default, or an optional 'from' date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/days-until-christmas/

from.description: Optional date to count from, in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

tools.name: hopi_dca_calculator
tools.description: Work out the average cost basis across a series of pound-cost-averaged buys. Each buy is an amount of money spent and the price paid per unit. Returns total invested, coins acquired and average cost, plus current value and unrealised profit or loss if a current price is given. Figures are treated as GBP. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/dca-calculator/

price.description: Price paid per unit on this buy

currentPrice.description: Current price per unit (optional), to value the position now

tools.name: hopi_dice_roller
tools.description: Roll one or more dice with a given number of sides. Returns each die result plus the total, highest and lowest. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/dice-roller/

quantity.description: How many dice to roll, 1 to 20 (default 1)

sides.description: Number of sides on each die (default 6)

tools.name: hopi_diff_checker
tools.description: Compare two texts line by line using a longest common subsequence diff, and report which lines were added and which were removed. An edited line shows as one removed line plus one added line. Comparison is exact, including spaces and case. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/diff-checker/

tools.name: hopi_discount_calculator
tools.description: Work out a discount and sale price. Mode 'pct': a percentage off a price. Mode 'fixed': a fixed pound amount off a price. Mode 'find': the discount percentage from an original price and a final price. All money figures are in pounds. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/discount-calculator/

mode.description: 'pct' percentage off, 'fixed' pound amount off, or 'find' the discount from two prices

price.description: The original price (used in all modes)

tools.name: hopi_dog_age_calculator
tools.description: Convert a dog's age in years to an approximate human age, using the standard veterinary chart. The later rate depends on the dog's size: small, medium or large. Returns the human-equivalent age. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/dog-age-calculator/

dogAge.description: The dog's age in years (0 to 30)

tools.name: hopi_download_time_calculator
tools.description: Estimate how long a download takes. Give a file size with its unit (MB, GB, TB) and a connection speed with its unit (Mbps or Gbps in bits per second, or MBps in bytes per second). Returns a human-readable duration and the time in seconds. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/download-time-calculator/

speedUnit.description: Speed unit: Mbps/Gbps are bits per second, MBps is megabytes per second

tools.name: hopi_due_date_calculator
tools.description: Estimate a pregnancy due date from the first day of the last menstrual period (LMP) and cycle length. Method: adjust the LMP by (cycle - 28) days, then add 280 days for the due date. Also returns the dates the second and third trimesters begin (LMP-adjusted + 84 and + 182 days). Dates are ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/due-date-calculator/

lmp.description: First day of the last menstrual period, ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'

tools.name: hopi_dummy_data_generator
tools.description: Generate fake but safe UK test records. Phone numbers come from Ofcom's reserved drama ranges and emails use RFC 2606 example domains, so no record can reach a real person. Returns an array of records, plus CSV text. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/dummy-data-generator/

count.description: How many records to generate, from 1 to 1000
